restrictions: unregistered pending serial registration after four additions
search_type 'web' or 'news' only; time_range any/day/week/month/year and domain_filter are instruction hints, not hard filters (as the source)
country, language, offset, content_options, unknown fields, provider_options other than model/reasoning_effort (including baseUrl) and unknown effort values are refused before submission
reasoning_effort minimal/none clamp to low as the source does (upstream rejects them with web_search)
max_results positive integer, clamped to 10; query at most 2000 characters after normalization; domain_filter at most 20 hostnames
results without a public http(s) URL (private/loopback/metadata hosts, userinfo, other schemes) are dropped; only rows grounded by observed sources/citations are returned
60s default and maximum total deadline, 4MiB success and 16KiB error response bounds
upstream error messages and bodies are never relayed
no answer synthesis, no streaming to the caller, no model discovery (the source exposes none for this provider)
